svg.desc: A dark terminal-style profile card titled WATCH ME BUILD. On the left, a stippled particle artwork cycles from a portrait of Yaseen Mohammad to a laurel-crowned Roman bust above the words VENI. VIDI. VICI, then to a rider on a rearing horse, and back to the portrait. On the right, profile details: name, role, location, focus, stack and a life update.
